properties.name: Increment 9 measured: read in full, reflow2 and notes both score ~24/25 at every size up to 240 documents; at 12 KB, reflow2 with the kit cue led at 60 and 120 documents (16.5, 15 vs 10.5, 6.5) and collapsed at 180 and 240 (5.5, 0 vs 10.5, 6.5), each time from a first read that spent the budget
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-10-30, increment 9, against the predictions registered before the runs (fact:predictions-for-the-size-sweep-registered-before-the-runs-2026-10-30). Material: 240-document made-up project (60,535 words), four 25-question sets as of D060/D120/D180/D240. Memories: notes file (arm B) and reflow2 0.95.0 design (arm C), each kept by 12 fresh Sonnet writers, frozen after B03/B06/B09/B12 (notes 56/129/217/318 KB; design 24/124/127/130 MB on disk). Blind Opus scoring per size (scratchpad sweep-key/scores-Q1Q2.tsv, scores-Q3.tsv, scores-Q4.tsv; mappings sweep-key/blind-mapping-*.txt).
SCORES /25 (D060, D120, D180, D240): reflow2 read in full 25, 23.5, 24, 24. Notes read in full 24.5, 23, 24, 24. Reflow2 at 12 KB with the kit cue 16.5, 15, 5.5, 0. Notes at 12 KB 10.5, 6.5, 10.5, 6.5.
PREDICTIONS: S1 (reflow2 full >= 22 at every size) HELD. S2 (notes full declines by >= 3) REFUTED: 24.5 -> 24; at 318 KB (~80k tokens) a full read still fits and works. S3 (reflow2+cue beats notes at 12 KB at every size, gap widening) REFUTED: it led by 6 and 8.5 at D060 and D120, then trailed by 5 and 6.5. S4 (notes at 12 KB declines) HELD loosely: 10.5 -> 6.5, not monotone. S5 (reflow2+cue within 4 points across sizes) REFUTED: 16.5 -> 0. S6 (notes writer round 12 >= 2x round 1) REFUTED narrowly: 118k vs 65k (1.8x). S7 (reflow2 writer within 1.5x) REFUTED: 264k vs 141k (1.9x), peak 400k (2.8x).
WHAT THE 12 KB READING LOGS SHOW (observed, not yet root-caused): at D060 and D120 the cued reader reached the writers' current-state record (search "current state", then get_node) and scored 16.5 and 15. At D180 it followed the cue's first half, read graph_report_markdown (6,575 B of its 12,000) and then seven searches, never opening the state record: 5.5. At D240 it ran scan_nodes, whose reply was 9,710 B, and had 0 left: 0 (it piped the reply through head, but the budget counts what reflow2 prints). graph_report_markdown measured 5,995 / 6,549 / 6,575 B at the first three sizes. Separately, at D120 the cued reader cited an establishing document on only 2 of 25 answers: the writers' batch summary records carry no D-numbers.
COST: total 6.54M tokens (estimate given to Anthony ~5M). Writers: reflow2 3.15M (per round 141k rising to 264k, peak 400k), notes 1.31M (65k rising to 118k). Answerers: reflow2 0.96M, notes 0.79M; a full read cost notes 80k/118k/158k/210k and reflow2 137k/183k/218k/209k across the four sizes. Scoring 0.33M.
WHAT IT MEANS: at this size no cutoff was reached for a full read; structure's advantage appears only under a reading limit, and there it is fragile: it holds when the first reads are small and lead to the design's own state record, and collapses when a first read's reply is large. Candidate defects for increment 6 (each to be root-caused before any fix): the first-read cue names a ~6.5 KB report first; a default scan_nodes reply ~9.7 KB; summary records written without their source documents. One run per cell; differences of 2 points or less are noise.
